description: This Java class defines a custom TrustManagerFactory that creates TrustManagers which validate X.509 certificates based solely on their validity period (not before and not after dates). It is used for SSL/TLS certificate validation within the Eclipse Hono project.

classes.name: ValidityOnlyTrustManagerFactory
classes.description: A TrustManagerFactory that creates TrustManagers which trust X.509 certificates only if they are currently valid based on their not before and not after dates.

methods.name: engineInit
methods.description: Initializes the TrustManagerFactory with a KeyStore or ManagerFactoryParameters; no operation in this implementation.

methods.name: engineGetTrustManagers
methods.description: Returns an array containing the custom TrustManager that validates certificate validity periods.
